deep-plum.$description: Deep Plum — Hero canvas, dark section backgrounds, page-level ground — sets the exclusive nighttime club mood

lavender-shock.$description: Lavender Shock — Pink supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

espresso-brown.$description: Espresso Brown — Warm near-black for card backgrounds, dark UI surfaces, warm-tinted borders — adds subtle warmth to the otherwise cool palette

ink-teal.$description: Ink Teal — Cool near-black for body text, deep card surfaces, cool borders — the teal undertone distinguishes dark text from the plum background

slate.$description: Slate — Primary body text on light sections, icon strokes, dense UI text

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Headlines on light sections, heavy text blocks, near-black emphasis

black.$description: Black — Maximum-contrast text on white sections, solid fills for condensed display type in light zones

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Light section canvas, reverse text on dark plum, card surfaces in light zones

mint-signal.$description: Mint Signal — Accent punctuation: highlight washes, badge backgrounds, small functional moments — cool contrast against lavender

amber-pulse.$description: Amber Pulse — Accent punctuation: warm highlight moments, secondary badges, energy markers — warm contrast against the cool palette

druk-condensed-super-desktop.$description: Display and section headings — extreme condensed bold that fills containers edge-to-edge; 151-317px for hero-scale words, 24-44px for subheadings

neue-montreal.$description: UI body, navigation, buttons, supporting copy — geometric sans-serif that stays quiet so Druk can shout; 58px is the bridge size between UI and display

arial.$description: System fallback for body text rendering
